question: The famous hill station Udagamandalam is also known as ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __Ooty.__ ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ooty :**

 
 
• It is a town and municipality in Tamil Nadu's Nilgiris district.
 
• The elevation of Ooty is 2,240 metres (7,350 feet) above sea level.
 
• It is the administrative centre of the Nilgiris district, situated 86 km north of Coimbatore and 128 km south of Mysore.
 
• **The Nilgiri Hills **are home to this famous hill station.
 
• It is lying in **the Nilgiri Mountains in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu**, this beautiful place is also known as **Udagamandalam, Udhagai, or Ootacamund.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Kodaikanal:

 
 
• **Kodaikanal** is one of the very popular hill stations in South India. It is **located in the Palani Hills.**
 
• **It lies in Tamil Nadu.**
 
• It is also popularly known as** the princess of Hill Station.**
 
 
 
• **Shivpuri:**
 
 
• Located **at an altitude of 1515 feet above sea level,**
 
• **Shivpuri** is a quaint city in the central Indian state of Madhya Pradesh 
 
 
 
• **Mussorie**
 
 
• Located on a 15-km-long horseshoe ridge with the grand Himalayas as a backdrop,
 
• **Mussoorie** spreads across at **a height of 2,000 m above sea level**. From this vantage point, it offers scenic views of the Himalayas peaks in Western Garhwal.
